   00056:   });
   00057: 
   00058:   // Metadata de controle incremental
   00059:   const metadata = await readSnapshotMetadata(lottery);
   00060: 
   00061:   const lastProcessedDrawId = metadata?.lastProcessedDrawId || null;
   00062:   const latestDrawId = bounds?.maxDocId || null;

   00064:   const upToDate =

   00066:     lastProcessedDrawId &&
   00067:     latestDrawId &&
   00068:     String(lastProcessedDrawId) === String(latestDrawId);
   00069: 
   00070:   if (upToDate) {
   00071:     return {
   00072:       ok: true,
   00073:       lottery,
   00074:       mode: "noop",
   00075:       reason: "snapshot_already_up_to_date",
   00076:       bounds,
   00077:       metadata,
   00078:       processed: 0,
   00079:     };
   00080:   }

   00085:     lastProcessedDrawId,
   00086:     25

   00092:     latestDrawId,
   00093:     lastCheckAt: new Date().toISOString(),
   00094:     pendingIncrementalEngine: true,
   00095:     pendingNewDrawsCount: pending.draws.length,
   00096:     requiresBootstrap: pending.requiresBootstrap,
   00097:   });
   00098: 
   00099:   return {
   00100:     ok: true,
   00101:     lottery,
   00102:     mode: pending.requiresBootstrap
   00103:       ? "bootstrap_required"
   00104:       : force
   00105:       ? "force_pending"
   00106:       : "incremental_pending",
   00107:     bounds,
   00108:     snapshot: current.data || null,
   00109:     metadata,
   00110:     pendingNewDraws: pending.draws,
   00111:     pendingNewDrawsCount: pending.draws.length,
   00112:     requiresBootstrap: pending.requiresBootstrap,
   00113:     processed: 0,
   00114:     nextStep: pending.requiresBootstrap
   00115:       ? "IMPLEMENT_BOOTSTRAP_SNAPSHOT"
   00116:       : "IMPLEMENT_APPLY_NEW_DRAWS",
   00117:   };
   00118: }

   00148: async function tryBoundsByField(db, lotteryKey, field, scanLimit = 50) {
   00149:   const DOC_ID = admin.firestore.FieldPath.documentId();
   00150: 
   00151:   const base = db.collection("draws").where("lottery_key", "==", lotteryKey);
   00152: 
   00153:   const ascSnap = await base
   00154:     .orderBy(field, "asc")
   00155:     .orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc")
   00156:     .limit(scanLimit)
   00157:     .get();
   00158: 
   00159:   const descSnap = await base
   00160:     .orderBy(field, "desc")
   00161:     .orderBy(DOC_ID, "desc")
   00162:     .limit(scanLimit)
   00163:     .get();
   00164: 
   00165:   if (ascSnap.empty || descSnap.empty) {
   00166:     return {
   00167:       ok: false,
   00168:       source: `where(lottery_key)+orderBy(${field})+docId(scan=${scanLimit})`,
   00169:     };
   00170:   }
   00171: 
   00172:   function pickFirstValidYmdFromDocs(docs, fieldName) {
   00173:     for (const doc of docs || []) {
   00174:       const v = doc?.data()?.[fieldName];
   00175:       const y = normalizeToYMD(v);
   00176: 
   00177:       if (y && isISODateStrict(y)) {
   00178:         return { ymd: y, docId: doc.id, raw: v };
   00179:       }
   00180:     }
   00181: 
   00182:     return { ymd: null, docId: null, raw: null };
   00183:   }
   00184: 
   00185:   const minPick = pickFirstValidYmdFromDocs(ascSnap.docs, field);
   00186:   const maxPick = pickFirstValidYmdFromDocs(descSnap.docs, field);
   00187: 
   00188:   return {
   00189:     ok: !!(minPick.ymd && maxPick.ymd),
   00190:     minYmd: minPick.ymd,
   00191:     maxYmd: maxPick.ymd,
   00192:     source: `where(lottery_key)+orderBy(${field})+docId(scan=${scanLimit})`,
   00193:     minDocId: minPick.docId,
   00194:     maxDocId: maxPick.docId,
   00195:   };
   00196: }

   00241:   let warn = null;
   00242:

   00244:     result = await tryBoundsByField(db, lk, "ymd", scanLimit);

   00246:     warn = e;

   00250:     try {
   00251:       const r2 = await tryBoundsByField(db, lk, "date", scanLimit);
   00252:       if (r2?.minYmd && r2?.maxYmd) {
   00253:         result = { ...r2, source: r2.source + " (normalized)" };
   00254:       }
   00255:     } catch (e) {
   00256:       warn = warn || e;
   00257:     }
   00258:   }
   00259: 
   00260:   if (!result || !result.ok) {
   00261:     result = await fallbackBoundsByDocIdEdges(db, lk, edgeLimit);
   00262:   }
   00263: 
   00264:   return { lk, result, warn };

   00274:       }
   00275:     }
   00276:   }
   00277: 
   00278:   // 3) fallback definitivo (bordas por docId)
   00279:   if (!minYmd || !maxYmd) {
   00280:     const fb = await fallbackBoundsByDocIdEdges(db, edgeLimit, { lotteryKey });

   00031: function pad2(n) {
   00032:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
   00033: }
   00034: 
   00035: function isISODate(s) {
   00036:   return /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.test(String(s || ""));
   00037: }
   00038: 
   00039: function formatBR(iso) {
   00040:   if (!isISODate(iso)) return "";
   00041:   const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-");
   00042:   return `${d}/${m}/${y}`;
   00043: }
   00044: 
   00045: function toUTCDate(iso) {
   00046:   if (!isISODate(iso)) return null;
   00047:   const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
   00048:   if (!y || !m || !d) return null;
   00049:   return new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
   00050: }
   00051: 
   00052: function fromUTCDate(dt) {
   00053:   if (!(dt instanceof Date) || !Number.isFinite(dt.getTime())) return null;
   00054:   const y = dt.getUTCFullYear();
   00055:   const m = pad2(dt.getUTCMonth() + 1);
   00056:   const d = pad2(dt.getUTCDate());
   00057:   return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
   00058: }
   00059: 
   00060: function clamp(n, a, b) {
   00061:   return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n));
   00062: }
   00063: 
   00064: function clampDateISO(iso, minISO, maxISO) {
   00065:   const dt = toUTCDate(iso);
   00066:   const minDt = toUTCDate(minISO);
   00067:   const maxDt = toUTCDate(maxISO);
   00068: 
   00069:   if (!minDt || !maxDt) return isISODate(iso) ? iso : null;
   00070:   if (!dt) return maxISO;
   00071: 
   00072:   const clamped = new Date(clamp(dt.getTime(), minDt.getTime(), maxDt.getTime()));
   00073:   return fromUTCDate(clamped) || maxISO;
   00074: }
   00075: 
   00076: function daysBetweenUTC(aISO, bISO) {
   00077:   const a = toUTCDate(aISO);
   00078:   const b = toUTCDate(bISO);
   00079:   if (!a || !b) return 0;
   00080:   const ms = b.getTime() - a.getTime();
   00081:   if (!Number.isFinite(ms)) return 0;
   00082:   return Math.floor(ms / 86400000);
   00083: }
   00084: 
   00085: function addDaysUTC(iso, days) {
   00086:   const dt = toUTCDate(iso);
   00087:   if (!dt) return iso;
   00088:   dt.setUTCDate(dt.getUTCDate() + Number(days || 0));
   00089:   return fromUTCDate(dt);
   00090: }

   00221: function normalizeRangeWithBounds(fromIn, toIn, minDate, maxDate) {

   00162: function clampYmd(ymd, minYmd, maxYmd) {
   00163:   const d = safeStr(ymd);
   00164:   if (!isYMD(d)) return null;
   00165: 
   00166:   let out = d;

   00168:   const max = safeStr(maxYmd);
   00169:

   00171:   if (isYMD(max) && out > max) out = max;
   00172: 
   00173:   return out;
   00174: }

   01048:     ? Number(a.prizesCount)

   01055:     : Array.isArray(b?.prizes)
   01056:     ? b.prizes.length
   01057:     : 0;
   01058: 
   01059:   if (pa !== pb) return pb > pa ? b : a;
   01060: 
   01061:   const ha = federalHourPriority(a);
   01062:   const hb = federalHourPriority(b);
   01063:   if (ha !== hb) return hb > ha ? b : a;
